SnackSaveToCloudDrive.description: Upload images and videos to your own cloud drive (Google Drive, WebDAV, Cloudflare R2), optionally end-to-end encrypted. Hover over each option for details.

provider.name: provider
provider.tooltip: Which cloud drive to upload to. Connect drives in the SnackNodes sidebar tab (click the status line below).

remote_folder.name: remote_folder
remote_folder.tooltip: Folder on the drive (inside the vault when encrypting); created if missing. Date tokens: %date:yyyy-MM-dd%, %year%, %month%, %day%, %hour%, %minute%, %second% (server local time). Example: ComfyUI/%date:yyyy-MM% Existing files are never overwritten (name_1, name_2 ...).

encrypt.name: encrypt
encrypt.tooltip: Encrypt file contents and names before upload (Cryptomator vault format); open them with the Cryptomator app. Set up the vault once in the SnackNodes sidebar tab.

preview.name: preview
preview.tooltip: Show the saved images on the node after the run.

keep_local_copy.name: keep_local_copy
keep_local_copy.tooltip: On: also keep the files in ComfyUI's output folder. Off: nothing is kept in output; the temporary copies are deleted after the upload or when ComfyUI restarts.

wait_for_upload.name: wait_for_upload
wait_for_upload.tooltip: Off (default): files upload in the background and the workflow goes on at once; progress shows on the node, and unfinished uploads continue after a restart. On: the workflow waits here until the upload is done, so the remote_paths / success outputs can be used for automation.

filename_prefix.name: filename_prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Name prefix for saved images/videos, same as Save Image. A sub folder is allowed, e.g. portraits/ComfyUI

stop_on_error.name: stop_on_error
stop_on_error.tooltip: On: a failed upload stops the workflow with an error. Off: the workflow continues and the success output is False (for automation). With background uploads this only applies to setup problems found before queueing (drive not connected, no vault).

images.name: images
images.tooltip: Images to save as PNG and upload.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: Video to save as MP4 and upload.

file_paths.name: file_paths
file_paths.tooltip: Optional: connect a text node listing existing files to upload, one per line, relative to ComfyUI's output folder, e.g. video/ComfyUI_00001_.mp4

0.name: remote_paths
0.tooltip: One line per file. With wait_for_upload on: a share link when the drive provides one, otherwise provider:path. Off (background upload): where each file will be stored.

1.name: success
1.tooltip: With wait_for_upload on: True when every file was uploaded (with stop_on_error off, a failed upload gives False instead of stopping the workflow). Off: True once the files are queued for upload.
